name: dead position (one-colour bishops)
note: A LEMMA of FIDE 5.2.2, not the rule (the dead position quantifies over every continuation, which no state-local clause states): kings and bishops on squares of one colour, one king each and the kings apart, admit no checkmate by any series of legal moves (Chess.deadPosition: one_colour_dead -- the check is a bishop's, so the mated king stands on the bishops' colour, its orthogonal neighbours fall to the other king alone, and a legal move keeps the class), so the spec's insufficient-material draw with no knight on the board is a dead position (dead_of_spec_draw); the criterion's knight clause is proved in the position only (Ideas.InsufficientMaterial.insufficient_material).
